target.role: fresh whole-journey contender discovery after Run 116's no-ADD deconstruction audit, spanning September 2026 current-release checks, adjacent Black experimental club and rough-kuduro work, and overlooked 2018–2022 form-resistant catalogue
target.purpose: Test whether agitation, failed rhythmic containment, assembly, competing meters, rupture or dissolution changes what follows at transition, local-run and long-form scale rather than merely adding another vivid mechanism.

explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 50 named tracks, releases and current-source entries across September 4–9, 2026 electronic coverage, Hyperdub/NON/Planet Mu-adjacent experimental club work and overlooked 2018–2022 rhythmically unstable catalogue; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT: The Guardian's September 4, 2026 electronic track survey, Pitchfork's September 8 Selects, September 9 reviews and current review index were inspected. Nueen — Shm survives as an exact current-release lead; previously decided Copicat, PISS, Silvan Strauss, Carmen Villain and Bitchin Bajas identities were excluded. https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/sep/04/add-to-playlist-the-churning-darkness-of-barcelona-producer-nueen-and-the-weeks-best-new-tracks and https://pitchfork.com/story/fine-djrum-miimii-kds-and-more-this-weeks-pitchfork-selects-playlist

ADJACENT / EMERGING CATALOGUE: Nazar's rough-kuduro single Bunker, Nkisi's AFRO PRIMITIV and Speaker Music's Black Nationalist Sonic Weaponry were inspected as distinct Black experimental club and form-resistance paths. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/nazar-bunker-ft-shannen-sp, https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/nkisi-afro-primitiv and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/speaker-music-black-nationalist-sonic-weaponry

OVERLOOKED RHYTHMIC CATALOGUE: aya's im hole, TSVI/Loraine James' 053 and Loraine James' Nothing EP were inspected for arrhythmic containment, competing drum systems, assembly and slow stumbling movement. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/aya-im-hole, https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/tsvi-loraine-james-053 and https://pitchfork.com/reviews/tracks/dont-you-see-it-ft-jonnine
FRESHNESS CHECK: current canonical, rejected, revisit, target-local discovery and 227-track utility state contain no prior artist-title decision for the nine requested identities.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and unresolved prior leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.

Runs 111–116 selected artist and label ecosystems were not retried; the scan moved away from Lara Sarkissian/P. Adrix, KAVARI/Overmono/Sote, Skrillex/Daphni/Sam Prekop, Helena Hauff/Mykki Blanco, Demdike Stare/Autechre/Laurel Halo and Lee Gamble/Ziúr/Errorsmith/Rey Sapienz.
Current-source entries without enough exact identity or candidate-level evidence were inspected but did not displace stronger catalogue leads; catalogue age was not treated as a defect.
No Spotify connector, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
